discriminators.title: SA 0xx area codes on shop boards vs Botswana/Namibia national numbers
discriminators.body: In South Africa, business signage carries a three-digit trunk code starting with 0 (041 for Nelson Mandela Bay, 011 Gauteng, 021 Western Cape) plus a seven-digit number, and mobiles start 082/083/072. In Botswana you would instead see eight-digit numbers with no area code and 7x mobiles, and in Namibia 061/064 codes with MTC branding. Reading the dialling code off a hardware or gas-depot board is often the fastest province-level lock in ZA.

discriminators.title: Palisade + burglar bars everywhere means South Africa, not Botswana/Namibia
discriminators.body: In South Africa even modest commercial and municipal buildings show galvanised steel palisade fencing, full window burglar bars and electric-fence standoffs as the default. In Botswana or Namibia you would instead see plain concrete-block walls, wire mesh or open plots with simple door grilles. Treat wall-to-wall palisade on an ordinary industrial street as a strong ZA marker.

discriminators.title: Municipal branding names the metro: use it before guessing the city
discriminators.body: South African metros brand sub-offices (traffic department, municipal court, fire & emergency) with the full metro logo, e.g. 'Nelson Mandela Bay Municipality', which pins the metro but not the town. In such a case, look for a retail directional sign naming the specific town; a satellite town like Uitenhage/Kariega hosts these metro sub-offices while the coastal Gqeberha core would show harbour/beachfront cues instead.

discriminators.title: Dry sun-bleached veld with date palms and blue gums = Eastern Cape, not KZN
discriminators.body: Inland Eastern Cape streets show pale, dry grass verges with Canary date palms and introduced eucalypts under a clear sky. In KwaZulu-Natal you would instead see dense subtropical green, flamboyants and sugarcane edges, and in the Western Cape fynbos slopes with pines and oaks. Combined with an 041 code this narrows to the Nelson Mandela Bay hinterland.
